Installation, Conversion and Examples move from level four to level three, preserving their subordinate relationship to How to.\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": false}], \"files_touched_count\": 2, \"file_examples\": [\"README.md\", \"doc/exl3.md\"], \"file_examples_truncated\": false}, {\"sha\": \"94ef28757e6390261e9a453ad80d11a697d72362\", \"title\": \"Initial commit\", \"summary\": \"Adds Ko-fi funding metadata and ignores common Python development and build artifacts, including the editable-install native extension.\", \"chapters\": [{\"id\": \"repository-configuration\", \"title\": \"Funding metadata and generated-file exclusions\", \"focus\": \"The new .github/FUNDING.yml sets ko_fi to turboderp, supplying a funding destination without adding application logic.\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": false}], \"files_touched_count\": 2, \"file_examples\": [\".github/FUNDING.yml\", \".gitignore\"], \"file_examples_truncated\": false}, {\"sha\": \"543c4b27714c6a677a6e714c452d62532f634cff\", \"title\": \"Initial commit\", \"summary\": \"Root implementation: quantizer, quantized-inference, conversion, models, modules, generation, sampling, loading-tokenization, runtime, usage-evaluation\", \"chapters\": [{\"id\": \"quantizer\", \"title\": \"EXL3 quantization: transforms, LDLQ feedback, and packed trellises\", \"focus\": \"Entry and calibration interface. Linear.capture_H flattens activation batches into rows, accumulates X\u1d40X in FP32, and counts activation rows. A qmap group records its first layer so shared inputs are not repeatedly accumulated. Linear.convert_exl3 passes floating-point weights and H_data to quantize_exl3, preserves the bias, and replaces its inner implementation with LinearEXL3. The quantizer's we\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"quantized-inference\", \"title\": \"EXL3 loading, reconstruction and direct quantized GEMM\", \"focus\": \"Loading establishes the representation contract. Linear.load tries EXL3 under the primary and alternate keys before trying dense weights. load_exl3 requires trellis plus an input-side su/suh alternative and an output-side sv/svh alternative, loads them onto the selected device, and includes optional bias. LinearEXL3 requires an int16, three-dimensional trellis; packed signs are int16, while unpack\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"conversion\", \"title\": \"Calibration, allocation and resumable model conversion\", \"focus\": \"prepare() requires a working directory and, for a new job, input/output directories and a bitrate. Defaults are 100 calibration rows, 2048 tokens per row, a separate head target of 6 bits, 8192-MiB shards and a 60-second minimum checkpoint interval. New jobs save args.json and initialize ckpt/job.json with next_module_idx=0 and surplus_bits=0. Resume reloads those arguments and the checkpoint; nor\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"models\", \"title\": \"Architecture dispatch and checkpoint-to-module mapping\", \"focus\": \"Dispatch uses config.json's single architectures entry, not model_type or remote auto_map code. Config.from_directory rejects missing, multiple or unknown architecture declarations and selects one of LlamaConfig, MistralConfig, Qwen2Config, Phi3Config or Gemma2Config. Model.from_config then instantiates config.model_class. A subtle distinction is that MistralConfig and Qwen2Config inherit LlamaCon\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"modules\", \"title\": \"Transformer composition, attention and rotary execution\", \"focus\": \"Composition and device boundaries. Module is a custom abstract base, not a torch.nn.Module subclass. It registers children explicitly, recursively loads and unloads them, traverses itself before descendants, and aggregates quantization labels and weight counts. prepare_for_device moves an activation to the module's device. Model.forward runs top-level modules sequentially under inference_mode, mov\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"generation\", \"title\": \"Dynamic generation, paged KV ownership and streaming contracts\", \"focus\": \"Job accepts one CPU token tensor of shape (1, n), or a list of such sequences sampled collectively. It keeps original prompt IDs separately from mutable sequence IDs, per-job RNG state, output buffers and stop conditions. Token healing removes the final prompt token when every sequence has more than one token, restricts the first sample by its prefix and excludes the healed prefix from emitted tex\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"sampling\", \"title\": \"Composable sampling, Gumbel noise and native matching\", \"focus\": \"CustomSampler.forward accepts logits, optional sequence IDs, a 32-bit seed, a tokenizer and blocked/allowed token lists. It flattens all leading logit dimensions into rows, runs the sampling steps and reshapes the selected IDs back to the original leading shape. sequence_ids is accepted but unused here. This is the local interface to generation; tokenizer.actual_vocab_size supplies the boundary fo\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"loading-tokenization\", \"title\": \"Loading tensors and translating text\", \"focus\": \"SafetensorsCollection scans *.safetensors directly rather than consulting an index JSON. read_header reads an eight-byte NumPy int64 header length, parses the following UTF-8 JSON and records the payload start. Metadata entries are excluded from the key-to-file map; later scanned files replace duplicate keys. get_tensor translates payload-relative data_offsets into absolute file offsets and assert\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"runtime\", \"title\": \"Runtime initialization, native interfaces and storage utilities\", \"focus\": \"The package initializer re-exports Config, Model, Tokenizer, cache classes, synchronous/asynchronous generation classes and samplers. The version is 0.0.1. This is a direct import-based public facade, not a lazy attribute loader; util similarly re-exports misc helpers.\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": false}, {\"id\": \"usage-evaluation\", \"title\": \"Installation, examples, and evaluation boundaries\", \"focus\": \"Installation offers two paths: install requirements.txt followed by pip install ., or set EXLLAMA_NOCOMPILE for a JIT-mode installation. setup.py uses the presence of that environment variable\u2014not its value\u2014to disable precompilation. Otherwise, when Torch is already available, it gathers C/C++/CUDA sources into a CUDAExtension built through PyTorch. The README also permits running scripts directly\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}], \"files_touched_count\": 186, \"file_examples\": [\"MANIFEST.in\", \"README.md\", \"convert.py\"], \"file_examples_truncated\": true}]", "truncated": false}, "base_commit": "942ecaf18bec9bd2eceb82126a26cf8c9e36ebb2", "cutoff_date": "2025-04-06T15:11:14+02:00", "evidence_catalog": [], "task_change_sections": [{"binary": false, "bytes": 1301, "header": "diff --git a/LICENSE b/LICENSE", "offset": 145}], "task_parents": ["942ecaf18bec9bd2eceb82126a26cf8c9e36ebb2"], "task_sha": "6551825ec4f61156ab5ca82b686811a9493ba290"}
